name: Sauria
blurb: The living reptiles: tuatara, lizards and snakes on one side; turtles, crocodiles and birds on the other.

fossilMin.taxon: Protorosaurus speneri (lectotype NHMW 1943 I 4), a non-archosaurian archosauromorph
fossilMin.formation: Kupferschiefer (cycle Z1), Zechstein Group, Glücksbrunn, Thuringia, Germany
fossilMin.dating: Re-Os: 257.3 ± 2.6 Ma (Wuchiapingian); the youngest date, 254.7 Ma, is the minimum
fossilMin.checked: Ezcurra, Scheyer & Butler 2014, full text: recommendations for calibrating the crocodile–lizard split

softMax.basis: Lanthanolania ivakhnenkoi, the closest relative of Sauria unambiguously older than the earliest saurians (Wordian, Russia)

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 107 ("Diapsids")
